name: message
doc: A message one actor sends, or a signal that only sends or only receives. Every message is sized by its body: each channel bounds its body, so a message that is too large for its channel does not check. A message type extends Message, and the router picks each one up by its channel.

variants.name: group
variants.doc: Every actor in a named group.

types.name: Message
types.doc: A message with a body of any type. Without a sender it is a signal that only receives; without recipients it reaches no one in particular.

types.name: Mailbox
types.doc: An actor's inbox and outbox: the messages it has received and the ones it is sending, in order.

types.name: EmailMessage
types.doc: A message a person sends by email. It always has a sender and a receiver, so the router can pick it up and deliver it into the system. The body is text of up to 200000 characters.

types.name: HttpMessage
types.doc: A request or response carried over HTTP. It has a sender and the url it is for, and a body of up to 1 MiB of text.

types.name: PhoneMessage
types.doc: A call or voicemail: the audio is the body, of up to 10 MiB, and the caller and the number called are required.

types.name: ChatMessage
types.doc: A text message in a chat: up to 4096 characters, with a sender and a receiver.

types.name: VoiceNote
types.doc: A voice note sent in a chat: audio of up to 25 MiB, with a sender and a receiver.

types.name: Material
types.doc: What a value is made of, as far as it has been measured. Every field is optional: absent means not recorded, never zero or none.

fields.name: characters
fields.doc: How many characters it has, where it is text.

types.name: Causes
types.doc: The four causes of a literal, and the metadata about who may use it. Every field is optional: a literal can be written short, with none of these, and cast into this form at any time. Absent means not recorded, so nothing here is a default claim. None of it changes the literal's identity.

fields.name: formal
fields.doc: Its type, as the type's words or address.

fields.name: efficient
fields.doc: Who made it: the author of the declaration, or the proof or sender that produced it.

fields.name: final
fields.doc: Why it was made: the purpose its author wrote, or the call that asked for it.

fields.name: licence
fields.doc: The terms it may be used on.

fields.name: cost_to_move
fields.doc: A declared estimate of what it costs to move, per channel. A claim, not a measurement.

types.name: Explained
types.doc: A value with its causes cast on. The causes are optional, so a bare value is the same literal in short form.

fields.name: causes
fields.doc: Its causes, if any have been recorded.

types.name: ExplainedText
types.doc: Text with its causes cast on, if any have been recorded.
